title: Personal Credit Cards: Tier Entry Ages, Line Bands and Deposit Requirement
content:
Every tier of Piedmont Crescent Bank's Personal Credit Cards is opened within an age band, carries a credit limit assigned inside a fixed band, and either does or does not require a cash security deposit equal to the credit limit. This schedule states those figures tier by tier.

| Tier | Youngest age to open | Oldest age to open | Smallest limit assigned | Largest limit carried | Cash security deposit required | Smallest deposit accepted |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Secured Visa | 18 | no maximum | 300.00 USD | 5000.00 USD | yes | 300.00 USD |
| College Rewards Visa | 18 | 25 | 500.00 USD | 3000.00 USD | no | not applicable |
| Platinum Low Rate Visa | 18 | no maximum | 1000.00 USD | 25000.00 USD | no | not applicable |
| Cash Rewards Visa | 18 | no maximum | 1000.00 USD | 25000.00 USD | no | not applicable |
| Travel Rewards Visa Signature | 21 | no maximum | 5000.00 USD | 50000.00 USD | no | not applicable |
| Visa Infinite Private Client | 21 | no maximum | 15000.00 USD | 100000.00 USD | no | not applicable |

**How the columns are read.** Age is counted in whole years at application. A tier showing an oldest age is closed to an applicant older than that age; a tier showing no maximum has no upper age. The two limit columns bound the credit limit a tier may carry. A tier marked as requiring a cash security deposit requires a deposit equal to the credit limit, and the deposit column states the smallest deposit the tier accepts.

**Distinguishing the tiers.** Only Secured Visa requires a cash security deposit, and its smallest accepted deposit, 300.00 USD, equals its smallest limit. Only College Rewards Visa carries an oldest age to open, at 25. Travel Rewards Visa Signature and Visa Infinite Private Client are the two tiers closed below 21. Platinum Low Rate Visa and Cash Rewards Visa share the same band, from 1000.00 USD to 25000.00 USD; College Rewards Visa carries the lowest ceiling, 3000.00 USD, and Visa Infinite Private Client the widest band, from 15000.00 USD to 100000.00 USD.
